# SAE (TAS-VANET) — một model cho mọi xe

<!-- generated by scripts/experiments_status.py from scenarios.json + results.csv; do not edit -->

- **Model:** Encoder 77 → 32 → 16, head trên [input 77, code 16] = 93 → 16; bản FL CE-only, 7.613 tham số lưu (4.528 dùng khi dự đoán).
- **Code:** core/sae.py, scripts/run_fl.py --backbone sae; centralized CE-only: scripts/run_central_backbones.py --model sae-ce
- **Protocol:** 5.343 xe nhận = 5.343 client, mọi client mỗi round, 1 epoch local trên fold train + val, 50 round, batch 64, AdamW cosine 1e-3 → 1e-5; centralized 50 epoch, batch 4.096. Headline = round 50 (CANPerFL: 10 epoch fine-tune sau FedAvg r50), view theo bài gốc. [protocol](../../docs/research/protocol.md)
- **Tài liệu:** [sae-single-model-baselines](../../docs/research/backbones/sae-single-model-baselines.md), [aligned-fl-v2](../../docs/research/aligned-fl-v2.md), [four-backbone-seed-results-live](../../docs/research/backbones/four-backbone-seed-results-live.md)
